fields.Name: T83 - Resources Record View
fields.Description: Verifies a Resource record opens from Data Explorer and that its detail fields render on the full form.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Resources' entity from the entity tree. Select the resource 'Artisan Brie Making Guide' (or any resource) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. Confirm the resource's detail fields such as type, category, and view/download counts are displayed. Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Resource full record form is open
The resource's detail fields are visible, including type/category and/or view/download count fields
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
